WITH date_range AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
),
fact_agg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk,
           SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_range)
    GROUP BY ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk
),
rolled AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name,
           d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id,
           SUM(fa.sumsales) AS sumsales
    FROM fact_agg fa
    JOIN date_range dr ON fa.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON fa.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON fa.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name,
                    d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id)
),
cats AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i_category
    FROM rolled
    ORDER BY i_category NULLS LAST
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT r.i_category, r.i_class, r.i_brand, r.i_product_name,
           r.d_year, r.d_qoy, r.d_moy, r.s_store_id, r.sumsales, r.rk
    FROM cats c
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT rr.i_category, rr.i_class, rr.i_brand, rr.i_product_name,
               rr.d_year, rr.d_qoy, rr.d_moy, rr.s_store_id, rr.sumsales,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rr.i_category ORDER BY rr.sumsales DESC) AS rk
        FROM rolled rr
        WHERE rr.i_category IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.i_category
    ) r ON TRUE
    WHERE r.rk <= 100
)
SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name,
       d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
FROM ranked
ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name,
         d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
LIMIT 100
